hypothesis: The v4 regression came from replacing a strong representation and decoder under an enlarged mixed distribution. Retaining the encoder and predictor while fitting a domain-balanced, baseline-regularized decoder should improve rare incident transitions without catastrophic forgetting.

candidate_grid.domain_weighting: Each of base, incident-v2 and stress contributes one third of the decoder fit objective regardless of row count.

selection_gates: no base-validation H1, H3 or H5 regression greater than two percent
incident-v2 validation geometric H1/H3/H5 error improves by at least five percent with no individual-horizon regression
stress-validation geometric H1/H3/H5 error does not regress with no individual-horizon regression
incident-v2 and stress validation false negatives do not increase
prediction-delta variance ratio is at least 0.10
selection: Choose the accepted candidate with lowest weighted geometric validation ratio, counting incident-v2 twice. If none pass, retain the v3 artifact and do not open v5 final test.
final_promotion_gates: v5 test geometric H1/H3/H5 error improves by at least five percent with no individual-horizon regression
v5 test false negatives do not increase
v5 test false-positive rate remains within two percentage points
the known v4 base, stress and OOD regression suites do not exceed their registered non-regression and false-negative limits
the artifact loads in the no_std physical runtime and all authority-boundary tests pass
authority: Even if promoted, the artifact remains unable to grant permits, approvals or adapter delivery. Digest-bound simulation caution is the maximum learned authority.
